text: Mara was fixing an old laptop. It had not been used in years. So dusty and broken fan. Also there was a stain on the mobo from coffee spill. She cleaned everything. She took off the back plate. Inside she saw there was some swollen battery, dusty fan and ribbons all over the place. She cleaned the fan with a brush. Replaced the thermal paste. Also re-seated the ram. Checked the disk. Powered it on. Didn't work at first. But after a while it turned on. Just the login page. So she didn't enter the password. The desktop had a folder for mom, and a doc for recipes, and a picture of a window with lemons. Anyway she shut it down. Basically she fixed it. But there's all these things people carry in there right. Birthdays, conversations, photos. Last picture someone took before they passed away. Anyway she shut it down and outside it was getting dark.
